objective: Bridge v2.0 end-to-end smoke — write scripts/bridge-smoke.sh printing 'bridge-v2-ok' and a matching Node assert test.
context:
Exercises the full autonomous pipeline (GPT task → dispatcher → orchestrator → ai-runner → Claude → PR → tests → GPT reviewer → final report) against the new bridge layer. After the run finishes, the following must be true simultaneously:

  - .github/ai/state/current.json.status == 'PASSED'
  - .github/ai/state/current.json.current_task == 'TASK-9999'
  - .github/ai/reports/TASK-9999.json exists and validates against .github/ai/reports/schema.json
  - A PR from branch agent/TASK-9999 is open

Cancelled by default so it does not automatically burn OpenAI + Anthropic credits when the bridge PR is merged. To fire the smoke test, change status from 'CANCELLED' to 'QUEUED' in a follow-up PR and merge it.
requirements: Create scripts/bridge-smoke.sh — a shell script that prints exactly one line: 'bridge-v2-ok' to stdout and exits 0

Create tests/bridge-smoke.test.js — a Node script using only the built-in 'assert' module (no devDependency additions) that spawns the script and asserts stdout equals 'bridge-v2-ok\n' and exit code is 0
Do not modify any file outside scripts/ and tests/
acceptance_criteria: bash scripts/bridge-smoke.sh outputs exactly 'bridge-v2-ok' followed by a newline, exit code 0
node tests/bridge-smoke.test.js exits 0 with no assertion errors
PR diff touches only scripts/bridge-smoke.sh, tests/bridge-smoke.test.js (and optionally a chmod +x on the script)
No new entries in package.json.dependencies or devDependencies
security_requirements: No secrets or environment values embedded in the script or test
The script must not touch any file — only print to stdout
